needed.board: the flight controller is a CubePilot Cube Orange+ Standard Set (ADS-B IN carrier board)
needed.telemetry: link telemetry: MAVLink to the ground station, and RTK corrections up to the drone
needed.companion_dds: link companion_dds: ROS 2 topics between the autopilot and the Jetson (DDS, the in drone half of the hybrid model)
needed.companion_mavlink: link companion_mavlink: MAVLink for mission logic and a UDP bridge to the ground over WiFi
needed.gimbal: link gimbal: Gimbal angles and camera triggers from the autopilot
needed.rc: link rc: Pilot sticks in, link statistics and telemetry out
needed.can: link can: RTK position, compass, barometer, LED and buzzer on one bus
needed.lidar: link lidar: Height above ground for landing and terrain following
needed.rtk: RTK corrections go up the telemetry link and on to the DroneCAN GPS
needed.adsb: the ADS-B receiver built into the carrier board
needed.battery: the PM02 power module on POWER1
needed.autonomy: a survey drone flies missions, a geofence and return to launch
